text:
kim: FYI incoming pen-test confirmed for next Tue (04/01). Assessor asked for an 'audit-proof package' — wants signed log digests + KMS metadata. Need quick plan for RBAC window and retest slot.

sanjay: ok. we can do pre-signed s3 bundle + KMS-encrypted manifest. will need an ephemeral role for the assessor for the upload window.

jess: we have an existing export playbook but it assumes full-read roles. For pen-test we should tighten to a scoped, timeboxed role and rotate creds after handoff. link: https://internal.redwood/docs/pt-exports (drive)

oliver: propose automation so it's repeatable. small script to bundle logs, hash, sign with KMS key, and upload. sample:```bash
FILES="/var/log/redwood/*"
sha256sum $FILES > bundle.sha256
aws kms sign --key-id alias/pt-handshake --message fileb://bundle.sha256 --output text --query Signature | base64 -d > sig.bin
aws s3 cp bundle.tar.gz s3://pt-handshakes/${BUILD_ID}.tar.gz --acl private
```

kim: nice. two questions: 1) does our KMS audit log capture the Sign() call (we need that evidence)? 2) RBAC window length — suggest 1 hour for upload + 30m validation, does that sound ok?

sanjay: yes, Sign() is an audited CloudTrail event in our KMS config. make sure the key alias is the dedicated `alias/pt-handshake` key so it's trivially scannable in the report.

jess: 1 hour + 30m seems fine. ops can own the ephemeral role creation and handoff. i'll schedule a short on-call overlap during the window.

oliver: also recommend we include a small manifest.json with: key id, key rotation timestamp (last rotated), signing principal, and SHA256 list. That covers most assessor asks.

kim: assessor asked about RBAC change review: they want a list of PRs/commits that touched authz in last 30 days. we'll pull from the repo and attach.

assessor-bot: reminder: please include log retention policy for included buckets and the earliest timestamp in the bundle. Also confirm whether S3 server-side encryption is enabled (SSE-KMS).

kim: got it. tasks: @sanjay create ephemeral role + pre-signed upload window, @oliver add manifest + signing script, @jess pull authz commits and schedule overlap. i'll assemble the package and QA it before upload.

sanjay: i'll create role with least privilege and post the Role ARN here once ready. target to have role + policy in staging by EOD today.

jess: pulling commits now, will attach short diff summary to the bundle.

oliver: putting script + manifest template in infra repo: infra/pen-test/onboarding-packager.sh. i'll open PR with runbook.

kim: retest coordination — assessor offered Wed 04/08 morning for retest. provisional slot booked 09:00-11:00 PT. everyone ok?

sanjay: works for cloud-ops.

jess: ok from prod-ops. i'll make the on-call calendar invite.

kim: great. final requirements checklist before upload: 1) bundle.tar.gz + bundle.sha256 + sig.bin, 2) manifest.json with KMS metadata, 3) pre-signed s3 link + role ARN, 4) authz commit summary, 5) retention policy note. If anyone sees gaps shout now.

oliver: i'll add an automated verification step that verifies the KMS signature before upload and fails the job if mismatch.

kim: perfect. thanks all — i'll post the final bundle link and handoff timestamp in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
